sources.name: VitaDB
sources.notes: Official VitaDB homebrew JSON feed. Requires POST with an empty body (no parameters). HTTPS is preferred; HTTP is used as fallback. Primary external catalog for version and release-date data.

sources.name: VitaHomebrewDB
sources.notes: VitaHomebrewDB community-preserved catalog. Used as the secondary external source to fill gaps and cross-check VitaDB data. The repository URL is retained for compatibility with the current hosted source path.
